title: Clockwork Sanctuary: The Historian's Meridian Key
premise: In an overgrown observatory driven by silent brass escapements, the historian must recover lost testimony without rewriting it using a chronicle decoding slate.
ending: Recover the Meridian Key and return with the unaltered historical account; Custodians of Dawn can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive charged gearfall while evading the watchmaker automaton without sacrificing the unaltered historical account.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Custodians of Dawn to witness the chronicle decoding slate.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal a compromising record
